full_page.content:
c. 1954
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of Handwritten messages on the back of photographs by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
( ON A PHOTO OF HIMSELF )
Blessed be God in all His designs ! To know God is to love Him. To serve God is to reign with Him. But, ? ! Thy dignity ! Thy excellence, rational creature! Q. And 0 ! Blueprint - purpose sublime ?
A. If gratitude is the very first, surest indi- cation of intellegence, what God sees first:
MAGNIF C AT ANIMA DOMINUM
God made me to know Him, O what a bles'd aim! To love Him and serve Him sure rests in the same. It's heaven begun - for the grateful - on earth! To treasure aright ! ! highest heaven its worth.
How little is it possible for mortals this side of Heaven to appreciate our holy Faith! or to be Fully grateful for its blessings, - its outstanding excellence.
Bless'd be God! for my past 4 and 80 years - as also for Sister Death in her patience if the Bl. God add other day or other decades . . Fr. Solanus O. F. M. Cap. P.S. Our faith - religion! The science of our happy dependence on God and our neighbor - of our living in His grace and dying in His Love.
( ON A PHOTO OF ST. THERESE. )
From the original negative now in possession of undersigned C.C.L. - a Carmelite III Order man
Vigil of Assumption Blessed be God in all His designs !
C.C.LINSTROTH 3940 Garfield St. Minneapolis, Minn.
God bless you Brother Leo. This is genuine: from the above C.C.L. himself - here this a.m. old friend ours in Minneapolis. Fr. Solanus, Cap.
